# CareFlow

> Windows desktop clinic management software for patients, OPD tokens, appointments, prescriptions, billing and lab.

CareFlow is an offline-first clinic management system for Windows PCs. Clinics use it across reception and doctor rooms over LAN with role-based access for Admin, Doctor, Reception and Lab.

## Primary pages

- Home: https://careflow.app/
- Modules: https://careflow.app/#modules
- Benefits: https://careflow.app/#benefits
- App snapshots: https://careflow.app/#snapshots
- FAQ: https://careflow.app/#faq
- Renew hosted services: https://careflow.app/renew

## Product facts

- Platform: Windows desktop (Electron + React + SQLite)
- Core features: patients, OPD tokens, appointments, prescription pad + PDF, billing, inventory, lab, statistics, doctors & schedule, users & roles, license modules
- Deployment: offline SQLite, LAN multi-PC
- Lifetime Windows license does not expire
- Hosted Online DB is $100/year on lifetime or $15/mo on monthly, then auto-off; renew at /renew
- Hosted WhatsApp Cloud API and AI Assist are $30/month (one fee) then auto-off; renew at /renew
